scope: Only new apiIdentityFactsS3 assembled with actual accepted certificate/observation/read/walker functions and original TF1/port in restricted fixtures. No collect or S3 routing.
behavior: Caller-owned shared work counters never reset; both observations, certificate files and public traversal use one supplied API window and captured certificate caps.
Exact report schema has seven writable scalar fields. Valid preflight permits cached finalization even for prelatched fatal; malformed report inputs cannot be promised finalization.

Actual cached live stop and exact window-owned stop are terminal. Cleanup uncertainty is terminal with exact primary, including falsy values, or a fixed fallback when no primary exists. Code strings do not confer terminal authority.
Ordinary identity mismatches retain legacy false/code behavior. Terminal outcome is selected before cached report finalization and exact rethrow.
Incoming cleanup failure performs no body IO or new sample. Failure reporting never samples; throwing-close elapsed time remains unknown.

Private context is non-enumerable; report and returned work contain detached scalar counters. Final checkpoint precedes successful identity publication. Existing functions, port and lib are unchanged.
